title: Spotify/music built-in tools now Music DJ package-owned
reality: v2.3.0 moved optional agent implementations (music/DJ, maps, calls, table games) out of the base Engine into downloadable packages (25,000+ lines removed; base exposes capability registries). The Music Player toggle without Music DJ installed now shows 'Download Music DJ Agent to configure' guidance instead of Spotify/YouTube/Custom player controls (2.3.0 Fixed). The skill's 'Marinara ships ~18 built-in tools' list presents spotify_get_playlists, spotify_get_playlist_tracks, spotify_search, spotify_play, spotify_set_volume, spotify_get_current_playback as always-present built-ins.
fix: In custom-tools.md 'Built-In Tools' section, annotate the Spotify/music tool bullet: as of v2.3.0 music playback is owned by the downloadable Music DJ agent package — these tools are only available when Music DJ is installed; without it the Music Player toggle shows 'Download Music DJ Agent to configure'. Also soften the '~18 built-in tools' count to note some former built-ins moved to downloadable packages in 2.3.0.

title: update_about_me: built-in status and Mari drafting handoff missing
reality: v2.3.0 explicitly states Conversation mode's About Me profile and the update_about_me tool remain built into the Engine and are NOT downloadable agents. v2.3.2 moved About Me *drafting* from per-editor 'AI Write' controls to Professor Mari — Character/Persona Convo editors no longer expose a separate model connection or source settings; Mari inspects the saved character/persona, writes the bio in their voice, and saves directly to the real About Me field.
fix: Extend the update_about_me bullet in custom-tools.md: add that despite the 2.3.0 package split, About Me and update_about_me remain Engine built-ins (not downloadable agents), and that as of 2.3.2 user-driven About Me drafting goes through Professor Mari (the per-editor AI Write controls were removed).

title: Package-gated slash commands (/illustrate, /selfie) and command toggles undocumented
reality: v2.3.0 hid image/video generation settings and the /illustrate and /selfie slash commands until the Illustrator package is installed (also renamed Connections' Illustrator defaults category to 'Images', kept /help first in slash suggestions). v2.3.0/2.3.2 made commands package-owned: the six table games appear in the Commands controls without separate Add Agent entries; package-owned command toggles appear only for installed agents; a package's commands appear alongside its agent settings as soon as the agent is installed. Per #3699 (2.3.2), installed Conversation games appear immediately in slash-command autocomplete and activate/deactivate their command and runtime contributions without an Engine restart (route-bearing packages still restart).
fix: Add a 'Slash commands are package-owned' subsection (or note near Built-In Tools) in custom-tools.md: /illustrate and /selfie exist only when Illustrator is installed; table-game commands come from installed game packages and surface in Chat Settings Commands controls; installed Conversation games hot-activate their slash commands without restart (#3699); command toggles only show for installed agents.

title: Gallery generation actions require Illustrator installed+enabled
reality: v2.3.0 (Fixed): Gallery generation controls no longer appear without an active Illustrator package — Illustrate, Selfie, Storyboard, Video, Animate, and Background actions require Illustrator to be installed AND enabled for that chat in every mode; Roleplay Gallery's separate Browse Images window was replaced by in-Gallery asset search.
fix: Where the skill covers image/selfie generation surfaces (or in the new package-gating note in custom-tools.md), document that all six Gallery generation actions are gated on the Illustrator package being installed and enabled per chat as of 2.3.0.

title: Connection Custom Parameters scope and value handling changed
reality: v2.3.2: saved Connection Custom Parameters are now applied to EVERY API-backed text generation that uses that connection — including Noodle and custom endpoints hosted locally — while per-chat and per-call overrides are preserved. Also (#3688) Custom Parameters now preserve arbitrary JSON values and convenient bare string values instead of discarding them as invalid drafts, and unified reasoning-effort requests were restored for dynamically discovered OpenRouter models.
fix: Add to the skill's connections/provider coverage: Connection Custom Parameters apply universally to all API-backed text generations on that connection (incl. Noodle, local custom endpoints) since 2.3.2, and accept arbitrary JSON plus bare string values (#3688). Relevant to anyone wiring custom/local endpoints for tool-calling characters.

title: Venice.ai image generation provider missing
reality: v2.3.2 (#3682) added Venice.ai as an Image Generation service, with authenticated live image-model discovery and native /image/generate support, model-aware sizing, and validated base64 responses.
fix: Add Venice.ai to the skill's image-generation provider list (connections coverage).

title: NovelAI V4.5 style plates missing
reality: v2.3.3 (#3725, #3726) added persistent NovelAI V4.5 style plates with independent strength and fidelity controls, plus optional subject-count framing that selects portrait, square, or landscape dimensions.
fix: Add a note to the skill's image-generation/provider coverage that NovelAI connections support V4.5 style plates (strength/fidelity, subject-count framing) as of 2.3.3.

title: Configurable TTS dialogue-line pauses missing
reality: v2.3.3 (#3718) added configurable pauses between generated TTS dialogue lines, with the saved preference shared across playback sessions.
fix: Add to the skill's TTS/audio coverage: pause length between TTS dialogue lines is user-configurable and persists across playback sessions since 2.3.3.

title: Cohere routed via OpenAI-compatible endpoint
reality: v2.3.2: bare Cohere API roots and versioned API URLs are now routed through Cohere's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
fix: Add to the skill's connections/provider coverage: Cohere connections (bare or versioned API roots) go through Cohere's OpenAI-compatible endpoint as of 2.3.2 — relevant when diagnosing tool-calling/param behavior on Cohere.

title: New env vars CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED
reality: v2.3.3 (#3730) added CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS for slow Conversation, Roleplay, and Game providers, and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false for persistent launcher update opt-out on Windows/macOS/Linux/Termux without disabling manual updates. custom-tools.md documents the related env-var family (CUSTOM_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS, CUSTOM_TOOL_SCRIPT_ENABLED, WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED) but not these.
fix: Add CHAT_GENERATION_TIMEOUT_MS (chat generation timeout for slow providers — distinct from CUSTOM_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS) and AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED=false (launcher auto-update opt-out) to the skill's env-var documentation, citing 2.3.3 #3730.

title: 'No central marketplace yet' now misleading — official Download Agents catalog exists
reality: v2.3.0 shipped a full-page Agents > Download Agents library backed by the official Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog of individually verified packages (Writer/Tracker/Misc/Maps/Calls/games, 29-package catalog), with install/update/uninstall, Install All/Uninstall All, startup auto-update to newest compatible version (2.3.1), and compatibility-aware catalog lanes per Engine major (2.3.3 #3712). CSS/JS client extensions remain a separate surface with manual JSON/zip distribution — the catalog does NOT distribute extensions.
fix: In extensions.md 'Installation and Distribution', rewrite 'There's no central marketplace yet' to: there is no marketplace for CSS/JS client extensions — distribution remains manual (JSON/zip) — but since v2.3.0 Marinara has an official in-app Download Agents catalog (Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents) of verified agent/feature packages; extensions and downloadable agent packages are distinct surfaces, and 'is there a store?' questions should be answered by pointing to Download Agents for packages, manual install for extensions.

title: 'Fork the engine' guidance stale — downloadable capability packages are the extension path for features
reality: extensions.md says extensions can't add new agent types/chat features and 'If you need any of these, fork the engine.' Since v2.3.0, Hierarchical Maps, Conversation Calls, and six table games are optional downloadable packages with package-owned server runtimes AND responsive client surfaces; v2.3.2 (#3690) added capability API 1.3 host services for downloadable packages (safe model routing, persistence, history/checkpoints, resources, logging, transactions, client contribution loading, readiness/retry states). The Marinara-Agents repo accepts reviewed contributions (contribution rules, PR templates, catalog validation, protected review flow). Forking is no longer the only path to new server-side features.
fix: Update extensions.md 'What Extensions CAN'T Do' closing line and the 'When to Use Extensions vs. Other Surfaces' table: add downloadable agent/capability packages (capability API 1.3, #3690) as the surface for new agents, games, maps, and calls — contributed via the verified Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents catalog rather than forking; keep the note that CSS/JS extensions remain the surface for client-only UI changes and are unrelated to packages.
